title: Sami and the Honey Bun That Wasn't Ready
youtube_title: Sami and the Honey Bun That Wasn't Ready | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets good things finish becoming what they are meant to be.
summary: Sami wants a honey bun that is still baking at the night market, learns to wait instead of taking a rushed cold one, and helps at the stall until the bun is ready to share.
